objective: Implement asynchronous Action submission, a durable permission-filtered GM inbox and delayed resolution by extending the existing A6 proposal/decision/Event architecture so one durable proposal can survive disconnect/time/device boundaries and still produce at most one final authoritative outcome, without creating a second asynchronous rules engine, queue authority or notification authority.

APW-02.rule: Async play extends ordinary A6 proposal/decision/Event authority; one proposal may produce at most one final authoritative outcome.

APW-07.rule: Stable operation IDs, expected versions, status lookup and Event cursors govern disconnect/ambiguous/retry recovery.

application_baseline.rule: Re-fetch current Multiversal-app main and migration directory before creating the APW-I03 branch. Inspect live A6 persistence/contracts first; claim the next unused migration only if durable async proposal/inbox/status metadata is actually absent.

primary_touchpoints: A6 Action proposal/decision/persistence and atomic commit contracts
permission-filtered GM inbox/review projection and optional coordination lease
A6 reconnect/Event cursor and delayed result return
D05 visibility filtering before inbox counts/ranking/notifications
safe attention/notification projection with fresh deep-link authorization
APW shell Waiting on me/Waiting on GM/Clarification/Stale views
completion_gate: A submitted Action remains durably pending across disconnect/time/device boundaries; proposal revision/withdrawal/expiry/stale state is explicit and versioned; GM inbox rows/counts are authorization-filtered before aggregation and queue position/lease grants no authority; every final decision reauthorizes current reviewer/proposal/session/resource/entitlement state; one proposal yields at most one final decision and at most one authoritative resulting Event; ambiguous retries use status lookup rather than duplicate submit/commit; delayed Player return resolves to the one current outcome; notifications are safe attention signals only; and the entire submit/review/decision/reconnect path works without AI.
required_implementation_questions: Which current A6 proposal tables/contracts already persist enough identity/version/evidence for delayed proposals, and what additive metadata is genuinely missing?
Does APW-I03 require migration 0011 on the verified baseline, and if so which A6/D21 or D12 owner owns each new field/table?
How are proposalId, proposalVersion and operationId related so revision preserves one intent thread while each state-changing revision has fresh idempotency identity?
How do submission timeout and ambiguous response perform operation/proposal status lookup before any retry?
What permission-filtered GM inbox projection supports safe labels, stale/clarification/deadline indicators and deterministic ordering without leaking hidden cardinality?
Is a review lease needed now, and if so how is it kept coordination-only and invalidated by lost authority?
How do clarification, proposer revision, withdrawal/revocation and server-governed expiry interact with a racing final decision without contradictory outcomes?
Which exact decision-time checks reauthorize role/delegation, proposal version, Session/Character/target versions, rules/pack/schema, entitlements, resources and hidden-information policy?
How is at-most-one final decision/Event enforced by authoritative persistence rather than UI disable state?
How does reconnect recover pending/final/stale/revoked proposal status and missed Events without blindly resending state-changing commands?
What minimal safe notification/deep-link seam belongs in APW-I03 versus later APW-I06 notification delivery integration?

Which cross-platform fixtures prove multi-device GM race, revision race, withdrawal-vs-decision, stale version, permission revocation, expiry, notification nonleakage, ambiguous response and no-AI manual fallback?
